component.name: MoleGraph
component.summary: Open-Source School Probeware and STEM Toolkit

description.p: MoleGraph is an open-source, low-cost school probeware system designed for hands-on STEM education. Unlike commercial "black box" solutions, it follows a "white box" approach, allowing students and teachers to understand the inner workings of measurement technology, electronics, and sensor calibration.

The software coordinates with open-source hardware hardware based on the popular Arduino NANO and UNO microcontrollers, managing up to 8 independent channels simultaneously with real-time graphs, multiple Y-axes, and built-in calibration tools. It is highly suitable for classroom physics, chemistry, and biology experiments.
